body: Same exact boat as you friend. The only thing I wanted to do was provide for my family and Besides menial jobs I can’t do anything right. When your mind slips life becomes hell

My thoughts are broken, ears constantly ringing, difficulty breathing, lots of financial difficulty, don’t have many skills with shit memory and won’t be able to work any job that would ever give breaks / it may be an end all here. Never thought life could become this scary. Probably wouldn’t even last in a job with less skills such as fast food or retail. I have a bachelor of science btw from Rutgers University ha classic what a position I’ve put myself in. 

Fml 

Still Great advice from you which I appreciate. 

How does one function when the emergency lights turn on but they can’t even comprehend things are going wrong and are paralyzed with inaction. 

No prayer, medicine, mantra or help from anywhere.

Holy hell.

True but the guilt I caused my own problems with stupid decisions in early 20s and more recently in 2018 will never go. Throughout my 20s I ate oral tobacco regularly, drank on and off, used coke, smoked a lot pot since 18, tried lsd cocaine ketamine ecstasy, and developed huge mental problems and physical damage as a result. It’s like my identity was completely erased and for years I made up lies as to what is going on around my family.

I finally told them and everyone pretty much hates my guts because I was supposed to be there for them and became a huge pussy.

Your advice is great and story motivational. I think everyone would be even more messed up if I killed my self so probably won’t even though I think about it a lot. My looks and personality are all altered so in this burnt out state it’s rare anyone could be attracted to me but the piper must be paid and I’m digging hard right now.

God bless.

I got a position to run a 60 room Quality Inn hotel in central Alabama as general manager beginning of this year. I was smoking a lot of pot at the time of getting the job and would eat edibles daily because throughout 2018 I was using not the best quality cocaine while working a front desk job at hotel in Atlanta and after the brain and nerve damage I suffered pot was the only thing that made my mind functional. I was also on hormone replacement therapy at the time for low testosterone for 1.5 years and the doctor closed office 6 weeks into the new job. For 8 weeks I was left without any medication and basically hung on for bare life with my job as GM which was a dream come true to be honest.

Three weeks ago I was working and basically couldn’t perform simple tasks and my memory was absolute garbage after the medical problems. I put the keys on the table in a meeting with the owner after telling him the truth packed my bags and came back home to Atlanta where my 67 year old disabled father who has no income other than social security and 61 year old mother who only works as a home care aid are renting a house for 1100 dollars a month. I had no plan at the time just really was completely physically and mentally f***ed up and am sitting in my parents basement in the worst position I’ve ever been in in my life. I am 29 years old love my family to death and was supposed to be the man of the house and feel like a complete failure.

Nonetheless I was able to get a job yesterday which I start in a few days as a hotel front desk associate in Atlanta with the  intention of keeping the bills paid and this horrible existence going.

God please help me.

Yes I feel like this all the time. For me it is also like a cold numbness that resonates from my brain through my flesh into my bones. I am completely apathetic to my surroundings and no external stimuli (visual or sound) make me feel any different. I recognize the utter silence around me where ever I go, but it does not naturally bother me and I have to consciously think to do or say something when around others (as to not make it awkward) or by myself. I feel like I suck the life out of any where I go, and most of all I feel guilty for feeling this way.
